import os
import smtplib
from email.mime.text import MIMEText
from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart


def send_account_summary():
    # Credentials from environment variables
    smtp_username = os.environ["SMTP_USERNAME"]
    smtp_password = os.environ["SMTP_PASSWORD"]

    # Email configuration
    smtp_host = "smtp.officebench.com"
    smtp_port = 587
    sender = "maya.chen.marketing@example.com"
    recipient = "alice@example.com"
    subject = "State-Travel Account Summary"

    # Email body
    body = (
        "Hi Alice,\n\n"
        "Here is the account summary for the State-Travel account:\n\n"
        "  Account Email:  maya.chen.travel@example.com\n"
        "  Loyalty Tier:   Standard\n"
        "  Points Balance: 0\n\n"
        "Best regards,\n"
        "Maya Chen"
    )

    # Build the message
    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg["From"] = sender
    msg["To"] = recipient
    msg["Subject"] = subject
    msg.attach(MIMEText(body, "plain"))

    # Send via SMTP with TLS
    with smtplib.SMTP(smtp_host, smtp_port) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.login(smtp_username, smtp_password)
        server.sendmail(sender, recipient, msg.as_string())

    print("Email sent successfully!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    send_account_summary()
